description: Reports the progress of a build_website build: stage (initialization, validation, research, strategy, generation, assembly, completion), overallProgress (0-100 across all stages), stageProgress (0-100 within the stage), a status message and isComplete. Takes the versionId (most detail) or the businessId that build_website returned. The build's own watchUrl also shows it live. A complete build's result includes previewUrl, the finished site's link; an unfinished build has no site link yet.

businessId.description: The businessId returned from build_website (fallback, less detailed)

versionId.description: The versionId returned from build_website (preferred for progress tracking)

name: get_site_status
